name: Line Trace By Channel
description: Casts a ray from Start to End and returns true if it hit a blocking object on the specified collision channel. The first blocking hit is written to an Out Hit result.

inputs.name: Start
inputs.description: Start point of the line trace in world space. Connect Get Actor Location, a camera location, or any Vector.

inputs.name: End
inputs.description: End point of the line trace in world space. Often Start + Forward Vector * Distance.

inputs.name: Trace Channel
inputs.description: Collision channel to test against: ECC_Visibility, ECC_Camera, ECC_WorldStatic, or a custom channel defined in Project Settings.

inputs.name: Trace Complex
inputs.description: Whether to trace against complex collision (per-triangle) instead of simple collision. Disable for performance.

inputs.name: Actors to Ignore
inputs.description: Actors to skip during the trace (e.g. the trace owner, the local player). Connect a Make Array.

inputs.name: Draw Debug Type
inputs.description: Whether to draw the trace visually: None, For One Frame, For Duration, or Persistent. Useful for debugging.

inputs.name: Ignore Self
inputs.description: If true, ignores the calling actor during the trace. Convenient when tracing from a player's camera.

outputs.name: Out
outputs.description: Execution pin that fires after the trace completes. Continue the graph from here.

outputs.name: Return Value
outputs.description: True if the trace hit a blocking object on the specified channel. Branch on this to react to hits.

outputs.name: Out Hit
outputs.description: Detailed information about the blocking hit: Hit Actor, Impact Location, Impact Normal, etc. Break Hit to access fields.
